response.reading_text: The city's decision to build a new highway through the park has been met with fierce resistance from local residents. The proposed route would cut through the heart of the park, destroying several ancient trees and disrupting the habitat of numerous wildlife species. 'This is a travesty,' said Sarah Johnson, chairperson of the Save Our Park committee. 'The city's priorities are clearly misplaced if they think it's acceptable to sacrifice our natural heritage for the sake of convenience.' The city council has argued that the new highway would alleviate traffic congestion and boost local businesses, but many residents remain unconvinced. As one resident pointed out, 'We've been promised that this project would bring in jobs and improve our quality of life, but all we're getting is a noisy highway that will make our homes uninhabitable.' The debate over the highway has been ongoing for months, with neither side showing any signs of compromise.

questions.question: What is the main reason why local residents are opposing the new highway?
options: to improve traffic flow
to protect their homes from noise pollution
because they think it will harm the park's ecosystem
to boost local businesses
questions.answer: because they think it will harm the park's ecosystem

questions.question: What is likely to happen to the habitat of wildlife species if the highway is built?
options: it will improve
it will remain unchanged
it will be destroyed
it will be relocated

questions.question: How does Sarah Johnson feel about the city's decision?
options: she is neutral
she thinks it's a good idea
she is strongly opposed to it
she doesn't care either way
questions.answer: she is strongly opposed to it

questions.question: What does the city council claim the new highway will bring?
options: more traffic congestion
jobs and improved quality of life
a noisy highway that will make homes uninhabitable
no benefits at all
questions.answer: jobs and improved quality of life

questions.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between the city council and local residents?
options: they are working together to find a solution
the city council is ignoring the concerns of local residents
there is no clear indication of their relationship
local residents trust the city council's decisions
questions.answer: the city council is ignoring the concerns of local residents
